description: This file configures USB Mass Storage Device (MSD) descriptors and endpoints for a firmware project using ChibiOS. It defines device, configuration, string descriptors, and handles USB events and descriptor requests.

methods.name: get_descriptor
methods.description: Handles GET_DESCRIPTOR requests, returning appropriate USB descriptors based on request type.

methods.name: usb_event
methods.description: Handles global USB driver events such as reset, configuration, suspend, etc.
